_comment: Onboarding questions for /organize. Claude asks them round by round with AskUserQuestion
(max 4 questions per round, 2-4 options each; the user can always type 'Other').
Keep the source text in English; Claude asks in the conversation's language. Answers are
To extend the onboarding, add a question here. Fields:
when      optional: only ask if answers match, e.g. {"desktop": "sections"} (answers not given in this run come from the current config)
(a list value means any of them)
set        config values to apply: {"dotted.key": value}. If a value is a list of folder names
(preset sections), Claude passes them translated into the naming language as
values_to  dotted config key of a LIST that receives the free-text values the user typed
(Claude splits the text into a list and passes it as {"option", "values"})
text_to    dotted config key of a STRING that receives what the user typed, as {"option", "text"}
since     onboarding version that introduced the question (users onboarded earlier are told
new options exist; they are only asked if they request a new onboarding)
